narr: Severe thunderstorms developed across western Wisconsin and moved eastward across southern Wisconsin through the afternoon and evening hours on June 22nd due to passing low pressure and its approaching cold front. There were supercell thunderstorms along with bowing segments along this line which lead to multiple areas of damage. Two strong tornadoes occurred, which were rated EF-2 near Argyle and through the south side of Janesville. Many reports of flash flooding were received due to torrential rainfall and slow storm movement or the training of thunderstorms. One of the other issues for this event was that it occurred on a Saturday evening where numerous large events were occurring which ended up cancelling or postponing to a later date.
ev: Several roads flooded throughout the county, especially in the Baraboo and North Freedom areas and in low lying areas. Portions of some roads and culverts partially washed out. A railroad bridge was damaged in Devils Lake State Park. Lake Delton and Prairie Du Sac also reported street and yard flooding. Some of the roads in low lying areas remained flooded well into the next day.

Street and road flooding in northern Dane County including some road damage. Some homes affected by flooding in Windsor, Medina, and Sun Prairie. A culvert failed in Windsor. Lowland flooding throughout the area.
Street flooding on several streets in Waupun and Beaver Dam, including backyard and basement flooding.
Significant street flooding in Orfordville at highway 11 and 213, and just north of Footville, and in the city of Janesville. Other street flooding reported in and near Beloit and Clinton.

Street and road flooding in southern and eastern Fond du Lac County with some road closures needed. This included the communities of Eden, Byron, Oakfield, and Alto. Some road washouts have occurred. Basement flooding as well. Flooding at a campground in the Kettle Moraine. Lowland flooding throughout the area.
